content:
Last week's near-25% off deal on AirPods Pro 3 is still live and may not last long, and we also spotted the matte black Beats Solo Buds dropping to as low as $41. But today's top story on 9to5Toys Lunch Break is Apple's official refurbished store offering up to $300 off the base M5 MacBook Pro, plus $100 off like-new Apple Watch Series 11 models, and rare discounts on Apple Sport Bands and Loops. After that we'll be looking at Anker's newest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand and 45W Nano smart display charger hitting all-time lows, along with Best Buy's updated back-to-school sale. Keep reading for all the details.

Amazon's near-25% off AirPods Pro 3 deal is still live and could end at any moment

Last week's Apple shopping event delivered one of the best AirPods Pro 3 deals we've seen to date. That Best Buy discount and the Pro 3 deals from that time have wrapped up, replaced by updated 2026 Black to School promotions, but Amazon's near-25% off AirPods Pro 3 deal is still live... for now.

Amazon is still offering Apple's latest AirPods Pro 3 for $189.99 with free shipping.

Down from $249, this is just a hair above 25% off, about $10 lower than the July Black Friday discount, and one of the lowest prices we've tracked since launch.

Best Buy's price already bounced back up to $200 this morning. Lately, this has been the price indicator Amazon uses, meaning Amazon's discount could return to full price at any time — if you're still looking to grab a pair this week, now is the time to take advantage of the deal. It wouldn't be a surprise at all — and frankly wouldn't be unexpected — if Amazon matched Best Buy's higher price later this morning.

We've only seen them go lower a handful of times — the very brief dip to $184 in February, and the more recent June Prime Day discount. Both deals have since expired, and there's a good chance we won't see a better price than this until the fall discount season, especially with Apple potentially launching the next generation next month, which could bring camera upgrades and a higher price tag.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (originally $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 (with ANC) $119 (originally $179 new) — Renewed Premium

Apple's refurbished store drops the base M5 MacBook Pro by $300

Although we're still seeing up to $500 off on that 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro, the entry-level M5 model has been notoriously hard to find on sale. But Apple's official refurbished store is offering an enticing deal on the base M5 MacBook Pro, with $300 off the 16GB/1TB configuration.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished store is now selling the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 16GB RAM and 1TB SSD for $1,699 with free shipping.

Originally $1,999 new, you can now grab one from the official source for $300 less, with a full 1-year Apple warranty.

For comparison and to further highlight the above point, Amazon is currently selling the same model new for $1,849. Amazon hasn't gone lower than this since retailers hiked prices at the end of June.

Although it's refurbished, we're talking about the most reliable source for refurbished MacBooks, and among reputable sellers this is likely one of the lowest prices anywhere on the internet for an M5 MacBook Pro while Apple still sells them new.

Anker's newest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand drops back to Prime Day all-time low (35% off)

I got a chance to test and review it when it launched earlier this year, and the Anker 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger has become a mainstay in my everyday carry, travel bag, and home charging setup. Now at nearly 35% off, we have another chance to grab it at the lowest price we've tracked on Amazon.

Anker's official Amazon store is now selling the newest 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger for $99.97 with free shipping.

Originally $150, this 3-in-1 charging setup features a MagSafe pad with up to 25W output, and both Phantom Gray/Black and Radiant White colorways are now nearly 35% off, well below the original price.

This week's deal matches the discounts we've mentioned before, hitting Anker's Summer Big Sale pricing and some of this year's Prime Day prices.

Although it's a palm-sized, highly portable unit, it has enough weight to sit securely on your desk or nightstand, equally suited for a home workstation or on the go.

You can use the main MagSafe pad while folded down, but flip it open to reveal the pop-out Apple Watch charger and the third Qi pad for AirPods, and it can power your whole device stack simultaneously.

  • 3-in-1 foldable MagSafe charger with 25W Qi2
  • Active cooling 'Cicada Wing' biomimetic airflow channels for '19dB quiet operation'
  • 25W total output across three devices: iPhone, Apple Watch, AirPods
  • Qi2 certified with MagSafe magnetic alignment • Supports iPhone 17, 16, 15, and 14 series
  • iPhone: Up to 25W wireless charging
  • (3.74 × 2.38 × 1.22 in), weighs the same as an iPhone 17 Pro Max (8.11 oz)
  • In the box: Anker Prime Wireless Charging Station (3-in-1, MagGo, AirCool, foldable), 45W USB-C charger, 5ft USB-C to USB-C cable, 2 anti-slip watch stickers, welcome guide, 24-month warranty

For a closer look, check out my hands-on review.

Base Apple Watch Series 11 models drop by another $100, starting from $299

Amazon is extending its AirPods Pro 3 summer discount into August, along with an all-time low on AirTag 2, while also bringing back $100 off most of the most popular (and lowest-priced) Apple Watch Series 11 configurations, starting from $299.

Amazon is once again taking $100 off all base GPS Apple Watch Series 11 models — the 42mm drops to $299, and the 46mm to $329.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)

These match the deals we tracked during Summer Prime Day and again at various points in July, and there's now another chance to grab one. As of writing, only the base GPS models have notable discounts — while the GPS + Cellular versions also have deals, the savings generally aren't deep enough to recommend pulling the trigger.

It looks like Amazon is having trouble keeping the base 42mm Jet Black in stock right now, but restocks should be coming at any moment — all 46mm color options are in stock with the $100 discount.

Amazon is running a rare 20% off deal on Apple Sport Bands and Loops this week

Score matte black Beats Solo Buds today for as low as $41

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Anker 5-port Nano travel plug adapter keeps you powered in 'over 200 countries', down to $20
  • Rare deal drops Belkin's newest UltraCharge 2-in-1 foldable MagSafe charger to $54 (all colors)
  • Sharge Mini portable power bank with Star-trail LED now down to $35 (originally $50)
  • This DOCKCASE SSD enclosure can display drive health and features power loss protection — now just $30 (all-time low)
  • Skip Apple's premium pricing and grab the LG UltraFine 6K Thunderbolt 5 monitor while it's $2,200 cheaper than the Studio Display XDR (new all-time low)
  • Nothing Headphone (a) discounted again: $159 in all colors, more models starting from $69
  • Nothing launches new CMF Clip Pro open earbuds with launch deal at $79
  • Latest Beats 240W braided USB-C cable (black) drops again to $18 for Prime members with free shipping, all-time low (40% off)
  • Anker 7-in-1 smart display Nano charging station with retractable USB-C down to $60

Best Buy updates 2026 back-to-school sale: TVs under $500, Bose $130 off, Apple gear, Ninja kitchen appliances, and more

Anker's 2026 back-to-school sale brings chargers, power banks, and Qi2.2 products back to Prime Day lows starting from $10 (46% off)

Anker is now running back-to-school discounts across its entire accessory lineup, with promo code SCHOOL20 taking 20% off everything site-wide, covering chargers, power banks, cables, charging stations, and more. The brand's official Amazon store is also matching many of these deals while offering extra discounts on several popular models. From compact Nano chargers to multi-port laptop adapters, MagSafe charging gear, power banks, and other everyday accessories — everything is discounted. Many of the Amazon deals bring prices back down to the same all-time lows we tracked during the recent Prime Day, giving you a chance to grab these best prices without waiting for the next major shopping event. Whether you're gearing up for a new school or work setup, or just looking to refresh your charging kit, Anker's sale has plenty worth checking out.

Anker's 2026 back-to-school sale is officially live

The brand's official Amazon store has added a few new deals, which I've flagged below, along with some existing ones for reference.

  • Anker 45W Nano charger with smart display $26 (originally $40)
  • Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 MagSafe foldable charger $100 (originally $150)
  • Anker Prime 3-in-1 25W Qi2.2 charging station with display $135 (originally $230)
  • Anker 160W 3-port Prime charger with display and touch controls $116 (originally $150)
  • Anker 140W 4-port laptop charger with display $65 (originally $90)
  • Anker 25,000mAh 165W laptop power bank with dual USB-C cables $105 (originally $120)
  • Anker Nano 13-in-1 docking station with detachable 6-in-1 hub $112 (originally $150)
  • Anker MagGo UFO 3-in-1 charging station $72 (originally $90)
  • Anker Nano ultra-slim 5,000mAh MagSafe power bank $44 (originally $55)
  • Promo code: SCHOOL20
  • And more...

One of the highlights of this sale is bringing Anker's newest 45W Nano USB-C charger with smart display back down to $25.99 with free shipping. Originally $40, today's $16 discount matches the all-time low seen during the recent Prime Day. That's 35% off, even better than the deals we've tracked directly from Anker. This is one of Anker's newer compact chargers, and all available colors are now at the same $25.99 low price. The built-in smart display can identify supported iPhone models, optimize charging for safer power delivery, and show useful charging info along with a few fun animations. The single USB-C port can deliver up to 45W output, and the foldable prongs keep the whole unit compact — perfect for travel, a tech bag, or everyday carry.
